briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and DeepSeek R2 escalate AGI compute arms race amid safety gaps

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs released multiple reasoning models this month while regulatory scrutiny intensified over autonomous agents. Funding surged past $11B quarterly as hyperscalers locked in new chip supply deals. Prompt injection attacks remain widespread in deployed systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI shipped o4 with 4x reasoning depth; DeepSeek R2 matched o3 performance at 60% lower inference cost. Anthropic and xAI both teased next-gen multimodal releases for July.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Nvidia announced Blackwell Ultra ramp with TSMC; Microsoft and Google each broke ground on 5GW AI campuses. CoreWeave raised fresh debt for 120k H100 cluster expansion.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will open-weight models close the capability gap with closed labs before 2027?
